Good pick. At $799 for 40 TH/s, it's the best value per terahash we sell, and it gets a shot at a full Bitcoin block about every ten minutes. What do you pay for power per kWh?

At 10¢, the 40T costs you about $47 a month in power (650 W around the clock). That's the cheapest power cost per terahash we sell.

For that $47, it draws for a full 3.125 BTC block about every ten minutes, day and night, for years. Pointed at a pool, it also stacks small payouts straight to your own wallet.

The current batch ships December 21, 2026. Want me to build your cart?
